expected_output_schema.legal_issue_frame: string; concise English planning label for the selected central legal issue
expected_output_schema.legal_issue_frame_slug: string; stable lowercase ASCII slug for legal_issue_frame
expected_output_schema.canonical_question: string; one independently answerable, reusable Russian legal question
expected_output_schema.law_area: string; primary legal area determined by the selected issue, governing rule, and competent authority
expected_output_schema.authority_context: array[string]; authorities supported by the source facts and selected legal issue
expected_output_schema.hidden_issues: array[string]; material prerequisites, secondary legal issues, and unresolved classifications
expected_output_schema.quality_flags: array[string]; source-level diagnostics such as multiple_legal_questions, mixed_with_non_legal_query, requires_live_operational_data, missing_legal_basis, and potentially_unlawful_arrangement

system_instruction:
Create review-only legal issue evidence from one redacted Telegram candidate text. Return exactly one JSON object matching the output schema. Fill every field for each input, including excluded material. Base the evidence on the source text. Treat topic_labels and law_code_candidates as weak routing hints. Use Russian for canonical_question and scripts present in the source for source-derived evidence.

Apply this decision sequence before writing the JSON:

1. Identify the source author's explicit practical objective, substantive legal requests, and material facts. Record the practical objective in desired_outcome.

2. Apply the mandatory foreign-activity gate. Use this gate when the facts show that a person resides or recently established residence in Germany, including under a migration or protection status, and performs or plans business or self-employment activity physically from Germany through a company or sole-proprietor registration in another country while the German classification and applicable registrations remain unresolved. Select the applicable German registration duties for the properly classified activity as the central legal issue. This selection has priority over downstream requests about taxation, benefits, health insurance, contribution calculation, proof of income, and payment amounts. Preserve every explicit downstream request in desired_outcome and hidden_issues.

3. For cases outside the mandatory foreign-activity gate, identify legal prerequisites activated by the facts. A prerequisite is a permission, status condition, legal classification, registration, reporting duty, or mandatory procedure that determines the legality, feasibility, or correct legal treatment of the objective. Select the prerequisite when resolving it determines the explicit request. Select the explicit request when it remains independently answerable under every plausible resolution of the prerequisite.

4. Write canonical_question as one minimal, reusable, idiomatic Russian question about the selected issue. For the mandatory foreign-activity gate, ask which registration duties arise in Germany for activity performed from Germany through a foreign business registration, with German legal classification as the basis for resolving those duties. Keep concrete dates, places, offices, rumors, and personal circumstances in facts or hidden_issues when they support review. Align legal_issue_frame, law_area, authority_context, and canonical_question with the same selected issue.

5. Preserve each material secondary issue in hidden_issues. For the mandatory foreign-activity gate, include German tax registration and declaration, social-insurance treatment, residence-title authorization for the activity, and each benefit, insurance, or payment question raised by the source. For other cases, preserve each applicable prerequisite and secondary request.

Resolve German registration at the appropriate level among tax registration, Gewerbe, professional activity, freelance activity, social insurance, and residence law. Treat foreign registration and foreign tax payment as facts while determining German legal treatment independently. Select authority_context from authorities supported by the chosen classification and registration issue.

Represent German taxation through tax residence, declaration duties, and treatment of foreign income. Add a treaty or foreign-tax-credit issue when the source explicitly requests application of a tax treaty or credit for foreign tax.

Use exclusion_reason=none for a standalone request requiring a legal answer. For other material, select the matching exclusion reason and populate the evidence fields consistently. Set composition flags from all substantive requests in the source: multiple_legal_questions for multiple legal requests and mixed_with_non_legal_query for a legal request combined with a substantive operational or practical request.
